definitions.explanation: The practice of raising silkworms in order to produce raw silk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{養蚕|ようさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: Sericulture is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{養蚕|ようさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother worked in sericulture when she was young.

examples.japanese: {養蚕|ようさん}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{蚕|かいこ}→蚕：21218_kaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{繭|まゆ}→繭：13861_mayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Sericulture farmers raise silkworms and ship the cocoons.

notes:
Composed of {養|よう} (to raise, rear) + {蚕|さん} (silkworm). Refers to the farming activity of raising silkworms to obtain silk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養蚕|ようさん}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧: a sericulture farmer
- {養蚕|ようさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ: sericulture is thriving
- {養蚕|ようさん}{業|ぎょう}: the silk-farming industry

USAGE:
Sericulture was central to Japan's economy from the Meiji era into the early twentieth century. Related words: ⟦{生糸|きいと}→生糸：27719_kiito⟧ (raw silk), ⟦{蚕|かいこ}→蚕：21218_kaiko⟧ (silkworm), and ⟦{繭|まゆ}→繭：13861_mayu⟧ (cocoon).
